💡 zedis | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing developers with a fast, efficient, and feature-rich graphical interface for interacting with and managing Redis databases, especially those with large datasets.
✨ Key Features: • Native, GPU-accelerated rendering with Rust and GPUI • Efficient handling of millions of keys with virtual scrolling and low memory footprint • Intelligent data viewers for various Redis types and formats (JSON, Protobuf, MessagePack, images, hex)
📖 Summary: Zedis is a high-performance, native GUI client for Redis, built with Rust and GPUI. It offers a smooth, GPU-accelerated user experience with minimal memory usage, designed to handle large databases efficiently.
